sections.st: Child-Resistant Packaging Manufacturer India — CRP Pharmaceutical Packaging GMP · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures child-resistant packaging from our GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom thermoformed child-resistant pharmaceutical packaging components for the pharmaceutical range. Child-resistant packaging manufacturer from Vapi for pharmaceutical companies requiring CRP-compliant thermoformed packaging. As a childproof pharmaceutical packaging manufacturer from India, we supply thermoformed child-resistant packaging components for domestic pharmaceutical and for export markets.

Pharmaceutical child-resistant packaging (CRP) protects children from accidental access to pharmaceutical products. Thermoformed child-resistant packaging components are designed to be child-resistant while remaining senior-friendly (accessible to adults). CRP design approaches for thermoformed pharmaceutical packaging include push-and-peel blister designs (child cannot push and peel simultaneously without the thumb strength and coordination of an adult) and re-sealable child-resistant pack formats.

strips.title: CRP Design — Child-Resistance Without Compromising Senior-Friendly Access
strips.desc: Problem: Child-resistant pharmaceutical packaging that is so difficult to open that senior patients cannot access their medication — this creates a patient compliance problem. CRP design must balance child-resistance with senior-friendly access. Solution: Push-and-peel CRP blister geometry designed and tested against the CRP standard protocol — child-resistance confirmed for children under 5 years, senior-friendly access confirmed for adults 50-70 years.

strips.title: CRP Regulatory Compliance — CPSC 16 CFR 1700 and Schedule G India
strips.desc: Problem: Pharmaceutical companies require CRP packaging components that are compatible with CPSC 16 CFR 1700 (USA) and Schedule G (India) child-resistant packaging standards. Solution: CRP blister base component geometry designed for compatibility with the specific CRP system the pharmaceutical manufacturer uses — CRP design confirmed from the pharmaceutical manufacturer's CRP packaging validation specification.

strips.title: GMP Documentation for CRP Pharmaceutical Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: CRP pharmaceutical packaging components require GMP documentation — GMP audit traceability for child-resistant packaging components is a regulatory requirement. Solution: GMP batch documentation, ISO 9001:2015, material CoA per batch — supporting pharmaceutical manufacturer supplier qualification and GMP audit.

strips.desc: Child-resistant blister base component geometry confirmed from the pharmaceutical manufacturer's specific CRP packaging system specification and CRP standard (CPSC 16 CFR 1700 or Schedule G). CRP compatibility confirmed before tooling design.

strips.desc: Push-and-peel CRP blister base designed so child cannot push tablet through and peel foil simultaneously — requires the adult thumb strength and fine motor coordination that children under 5 years lack.
